title: integrations
subHeroTitle: KeilHQ fits into the tools you already use.
subHeroDesc: Connect Google Workspace, GitHub, Notion, and more — so your team doesn't have to choose between the tools they know and the workspace that keeps everything together.

sections.title: Connect the tools your team already relies on
sections.desc: One authorization connects Google Calendar, Gmail, GitHub, Notion, and more. Your data flows into KeilHQ automatically — no manual syncing, no copy-pasting between tabs.

gridItems.title: Google Workspace
gridItems.desc: Connect Calendar, Gmail, Drive, Docs, Meet, Sheets, and Slides with a single sign-in. Your schedule and files are always in sync.

gridItems.title: GitHub
gridItems.desc: Link your repositories so your AI assistant can view open pull requests, create issues from tasks, and keep engineering and project management in sync.

gridItems.title: Notion
gridItems.desc: Connect Notion and your documents stay synchronized in both directions — no manual exporting or importing.

gridItems.title: Slack & Linear
gridItems.desc: Push workspace notifications into Slack channels and keep Linear project boards in sync with your KeilHQ tasks.

sections.title: Stay on top of what needs your attention
sections.desc: KeilHQ sends you alerts when something changes — a task is assigned, a comment is left, or someone mentions you. Smart filters mean you only hear about the things that actually matter.

gridItems.title: Smart alerts
gridItems.desc: Get notified when tasks are assigned to you, when someone comments on your work, or when you're mentioned in a conversation.

gridItems.title: Instant delivery
gridItems.desc: Notifications arrive the moment something happens — across every open tab, with no delay.

gridItems.title: Focus mode
gridItems.desc: Set quiet hours or filter out the alert types that don't need your immediate attention. Less noise, more focus.

capabilitiesDesc: Stop switching between apps. Bring your entire toolkit into KeilHQ and let everything work together.
checklistDesc: Integrations aren't an afterthought in KeilHQ — they're how your whole team's work stays connected without anyone doing manual updates.
checklistItems: Connect Google Calendar so your tasks and meetings stay in sync automatically — no double-entry required.
Link Gmail to send emails directly from contact records without opening another tab.
Connect GitHub so pull requests, issues, and code activity are visible right next to your project tasks.
Sync documents with Notion so your team can work from both platforms without keeping two copies in sync manually.
Get notified the moment something needs your attention — and filter out everything that doesn't.
